content: Reddit CMV data. The CMV dataset is constructed from conversations collected via the Reddit API. In contrast to the Wikipedia-based dataset, we explicitly avoid the use of post-hoc annotation. Instead, we use as our label whether a conversation eventually had a comment removed by a moderator for violation of Rule 2: “Don't be rude or hostile to other users”.
